abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 3. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 213 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 269 | 400 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 8.7 | 4.3 | 400 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 8.4 | 4.2 | 400 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
